description: Fabric mod — display real player skins on CEM model submodels via a $Username$ token in the entity name

mods.name: Player Skin Extension for ETF
mods.description: Adds $username$ player-skin tokens for ETF/OptiFine-style entity texture workflows.

releases.notes:
# Player Skin Extension for ETF 1.0.1

Adds a much more powerful dynamic player asset system.

## New features

- Dynamic player capes
- Dynamic player elytra textures
- `player_asset.X=skin/cape/elytra`
- Legacy `player.X=true` still works
- Hidden `-flag` tokens in names
- Better compatibility with ETF texture variants
- Support for dynamic textures on non-`player.png` CEM texture files
- Example support for regular/slim arm switching using `-slim`

## Example

`$Steve$ drops a mic -slim -cape`

Displays as:

`Steve drops a mic`

but internally uses:
- Steve skin
- slim model flag
- Steve cape, if available

releases.notes:
# Initial release of Player Skin Extension for ETF (pse-etf).

Adds dynamic player skin rendering in CEM models using "$Username$" tokens in entity names.

Supports:
- Minecraft 26.1 (Fabric)
- Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3
- Fabric API
- Entity Model Features (required for CEM support)
- Entity Texture Features (optional)

Client-side only.

## Also attached a resource pack, just paste "$Steve$ drops a mic" and put a username instead of Steve, and see how it works.
